item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:10 AM 03 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro, Baco, Pola, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Gloria, Bulalacao, CityOfCalapan, Naujan, Victoria), #Marinduque(Gasan, Buenavista, Boac), #Romblon(Banton, Concepcion), #Masbate(Aroroy, Baleno), #Albay(RapuRapu, Bacacay, LegazpiCity, Manito, Malilipot, SantoDomingo, CityOfTabaco, Malinao, Tiwi), #CamarinesSur(Tigaon, SanJose, Presentacion, Caramoan, Sagñay, Sipocot, Cabusao, Calabanga, Tinambac, Siruma), #Catanduanes(SanAndres), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes and Basud) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Bansud, Bongabong, Mansalay, Roxas), #Romblon(Alcantara, Cajidiocan, Calatrava, Corcuera, Looc, Magdiwang, Odiongan, Romblon, SanAgustin, SanAndres, SanFernando, SanJose, SantaFe, Ferrol, SantaMaria), #Masbate(Mandaon, Balud and Milagros) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
